description: Get current and recent global disaster alerts from the UN GDACS system. Returns earthquakes, tropical cyclones, floods, volcanoes, droughts, and tsunamis with color-coded severity (Green/Orange/Red), affected country, coordinates, and population impact estimates.

alert_level.description: Minimum alert level filter: Green (low), Orange (medium), Red (high impact)

event_type.description: Filter by disaster type: EQ=earthquake, TC=tropical cyclone, FL=flood, VO=volcano, DR=drought, TS=tsunami

limit.description: Number of events to return, max 50 (default 10)

name: gdacs.disasters.alerts

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Global Disaster Alerts (UN)
